author: Arcani test fixtures
rationale: Rate curve fixture (Story 2.6), schema-valid and rejected at compile: a 200 Hz gamma carrier with a gamma rate cycle of 45 Hz plus or minus 10 Hz. The center passes the carrier rule (200 Hz is at least 4 x 45 Hz), the highest rate does not (4 x 55 Hz = 220 Hz). 100 percent depth, uncoupled, 60 s period, start phase 0 degrees, 5 s. Values are placeholders, not starter defaults. A test fixture, not for listening.
